rationale: OnPoint resolves to OnPoint Energy, LLC, a Houston-based retail-electricity platform formed by ArcLight in 2022, not a power-generation fleet. The operating business sold or transferred its Texas customer contracts to Good Charlie on 2024-01-30, stated that it had transferred all customers and was no longer providing retail electric service, cancelled the final OnPoint federal market-based-rate tariff effective 2024-01-31, and later had Texas REP certificate 10326 revoked. ArcLight still lists OnPoint as a Current Power investment, which supports retained manager ownership of a residual investment/entity rather than a currently operating infrastructure platform. The appropriate census treatment is exclusion as a non-operating wind-down or dormant holding shell.

identityResolution.headquarters: Houston, Texas, United States (last publicly disclosed)
identityResolution.platformBoundary: Manager-level retail-electricity platform represented by OnPoint Energy, LLC. Regulated activity was conducted through same-name legal entities including OnPoint Energy Texas, LLC and the Illinois, Ohio, Pennsylvania/Northeast market-based-rate entities. Direct sources identify a retail supplier and energy-marketing platform; no owned generation fleet or physical-infrastructure asset portfolio was identified. The regulatory entities should not be counted separately at manager level.
identityResolution.duplicateDecision: Distinct from Onward Energy. FERC lists the OnPoint entities and Onward Energy Management, LLC under separate legal names and CIDs, and no direct source establishes an alias, predecessor, successor, merger, or ownership relationship between them.

operatingResolution.subsector: Retail electricity supply and energy marketing
operatingResolution.description: ArcLight-sponsored retail electric provider formed to sell electricity plans to residential, commercial, and industrial customers, initially in ERCOT; it was intended to support commercial optimization of ArcLight's power fleet but did not itself constitute that generation fleet.
operatingResolution.companyStatus: NON-OPERATING / WIND-DOWN; customer service ceased and federal and state operating authorizations were cancelled or revoked, while ArcLight still carries the residual investment as Current.
operatingResolution.services: Former retail electricity enrollment, pricing, billing, account management, and customer service.
operatingResolution.footprint: Confirmed commercial operations were in Texas/ERCOT. Illinois, Ohio, and Pennsylvania/Northeast entities made federal market-based-rate filings, but no direct source verified a commercial customer launch outside Texas; those federal tariffs were subsequently cancelled or consolidated and then cancelled.

acquisitionExitCheck.formationOrAcquisition: ArcLight announced the greenfield formation of OnPoint Energy, LLC and a $50 million commitment to retail initiatives on 2022-08-17. No predecessor acquisition was disclosed.
acquisitionExitCheck.legalClosing: NOT_PUBLICLY_DISCLOSED. No separate legal-closing announcement was found; transaction counsel described the matter as an ArcLight investment on 2022-08-19.
acquisitionExitCheck.subsequentExitSearch: OnPoint agreed on 2024-01-30 to sell or transfer its Texas customer contracts and customer lists to Good Charlie, then stated in the PUCT proceeding that it had transferred all customers and was no longer providing retail electric service. OnPoint Energy Northeast, LLC filed to cancel the platform's remaining federal market-based-rate tariff effective 2024-01-31. PUCT final-order materials dated 2025-11-14 report revocation of REP certificate 10326. Exact-name and legal-entity searches found no public sale of OnPoint Energy, LLC itself, merger, rename, dissolution, bankruptcy, or signed pending parent-level ownership transaction through 2026-08-14; ArcLight's live portfolio page still labels OnPoint Current.

milestones.event: ArcLight announced formation of OnPoint Energy, LLC, a Houston-headquartered retail electric provider initially focused on ERCOT, and committed $50 million to retail initiatives.
OnPoint's Illinois, Ohio, and Pennsylvania entities filed initial FERC market-based-rate applications.
OnPoint agreed to sell or transfer its Texas customer contracts and customer lists to Good Charlie; its remaining federal market-based-rate tariff was filed for cancellation effective 2024-01-31.
The PUCT entered final-order action in Docket 58756 and reported revocation of OnPoint Energy Texas, LLC's REP certificate 10326.

unresolvedQuestions: ArcLight's specific fund, legal holding vehicle, and ownership percentage are NOT_PUBLICLY_DISCLOSED.
The residual parent entity's current state-law good-standing or dissolution status and any remaining non-customer assets or liabilities are NOT_PUBLICLY_DISCLOSED.
The PUCT alphabetical REP directory still displays certificate 10326 despite the later final-order and revocation record; this appears to be an administratively stale directory entry.
recommendedListAction: Exclude from the active manager-level operating-company census. Retain only as a historical or current-unrealized wind-down record if the data model tracks residual investments. Do not map it to Onward Energy or Good Charlie, and do not count the OnPoint regulatory entities separately.
